description: List a product model's catalog with stock and variant info (onHand/reserved/available per record and variant). A product is a record of a model whose product capability is enabled (get_model shows `product.enabled` and the field roles): create one with create_record on that model and change it with update_record; set_product_tiers and the bulk_* product tools work on the same records. Each record carries `url`: its live storefront link, built by the server from the model's urlPattern and the site's public site URL. Use it whenever you link to a record and never build a storefront URL yourself (not from a slug, not from the site address). When url is null or missing, say why instead of guessing: the model has no urlPattern (set it with update_model), the model is not delivered (deliveryAccess none, or it is the login model), the site has no public site URL, or the record - or one it links to - is unpublished.
